key_insight: Perfumer is an LLM-based agentic framework that combines Quantum ESPRESSO with learned models to accelerate crystal relaxation and predict electronic bands.
engineering_relevance: Natural-language workflows can reduce setup effort and computational cost when screening candidate materials for structural and electronic properties.
method: Use Perfumer-relax for pre-relaxation, followed by Quantum ESPRESSO refinement.
Predict 12 band energies at requested wavevectors using a periodic graph neural network and latent Hermitian spectral head.
Preserve reciprocal-lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without explicitly constructing a Hamiltonian.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2.75× overall relaxation speedup on tested structures; trained on 125,153 band structures, the band model achieved 0.157 eV median per-material MAE on 2,607 held-out-composition test materials spanning 85 elements, at about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores.
watch_item: Band predictions are limited to 12 energies per wavevector; suitability for unseen chemistries and accuracy-sensitive applications requires validation.
paper_title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
